resources.string: The original audio stays here until a saved document contains it. Adding it is an edit you still need to save. If you’re unsure, keep it for later.
The original recording was kept. Open recording recovery to choose what to do.
The recording details can’t be read. They are kept as they are; audio without a document is listed separately.
The original audio is missing or empty. Its recovery details have been kept.
Open the document to add this audio to. The open document changed, so start the recovery again.
This recording is already in the document. The original audio is kept until it’s confirmed saved.
This audio was previously added. It may have been undone or removed; restore it only if you want it back.
Couldn’t confirm the original document. You can add the audio as a separate recording, not linked to existing ink.
These details belong to another document or recording. You can add the audio separately.
The audio is ready to restore with its original ink association.
